name: pharynx
definition: Swollen region of the anterior foregut, posterior to the mouth and anterior to the liver; its walls form the jaws and gills.

events.text: Pharyngeal endoderm present (10-13 somites).
Pharyngeal pouches 2 to 6 have formed; small open mouth located between the eyes.
Mouth protrudes anterior to the eye; pharynx connects mouth to esophagus.
Gill filaments and teeth in place; feeding begins.

name: proctodeum

name: liver
definition: Solid compound organ with three lobes that has many functions including bile production, blood detoxification, the production of critical plasma proteins and clotting factors, complement proteins and the storage of many substances, such as lipids, amino acids, iron, and glycogen. name: ceratobranchial 5 tooth
definition: Is a multi-tissue structure composed of dentine, enameloid and tooth pulp. The tips of the ceratobranchial 5 teeth form before the ceratobranchial itself (3.0 mm NL). As they grow ventrally, they meet the perichondrally ossified surface of ceratobranchial 5 and become firmly ankylosed to the bone. Ceratobranchial teeth are the only teeth present in zebrafish and other cypriniforms.
overrideNote: ZFA starts the ceratobranchial 5 tooth at Long-pec (48 hpf) with the tooth germ 4V; the atlas draws the teeth from 72 hpf, when 4V mineralises and 3V starts, so the cones appear with the open mouth (Van der heyden and Huysseune 2000 Dev Dyn 219:486-496, PMID 11084648; the hours are estimates, research 03d). DM-36: axis clamp at 4320 hpf.

Phase 2 visual calibration: keyframes that crossed the body outline after the layout pass were seated toward the spine in steps of 1.5 percent, and shrunk in steps of 3 percent only when seating alone did not close the gap, until every vertex builds inside the skin.

Phase 2 visual calibration (VR-04, RN-07): the adult path is six points, not four, and it folds. From 720 hpf the mid intestine leaves the midline to the right and rises and falls between the swim-bladder floor and the belly wall, so the lateral view shows a loop behind the intestinal bulb and the dorsal view shows the tube swing off the midline. The intestine posterior to the bulb is also 0.75 of its former radius at 25 mm SL (0.70 mm across, inside the 0.6 to 1.0 mm the literature gives), which is what leaves the coelom room for the fold; the junction radii of the neighbouring segment records follow it. The fold amplitude is the largest the sweep rule E036 allows (r x kappa below 0.9), and countLoops is 0 where the path carries the fold so the two displacements do not add.

name: intestinal rod
definition: Multicellular structure composed of endodermal cells that forms a continuous rod along the anterior-posterior axis of the embryo in contact with the YSL. This rod will give rise to the endodermal components of the alimentary canal and its connected organs: liver, gall bladder pancreas and swim bladder. Does not have part pharyngeal endoderm.
